amendment_review.correction: Keep the vault part. Keep the Corbanu-home read part, citing the coordinator brief ('protected reads are never grantable') for 'cannot be granted'. Drop the requirement that the inspector show restart-only protections as 'starting at the restart': only screen 07 must name them (#443, #505, brief). Restore the frozen clause: 'Protections not yet active (the restart-only list) are not shown as active in the inspector'. If the inspector lists vault refusal or Corbanu-home protection, it must not show them as inactive.

Restore the frozen wording 'or the OS denies the command ('Operation not permitted')'; the row says unchanged but drops it. Add (#442 19:55 point 1): the denial text does not suggest only .env files found at start are protected.

Apply 'cannot be granted, not even once, and how to change the level' to the ls ~/Library/Keychains denial too, since keychains are protected credential files (#442 08:17). Apply it to security find-generic-password if that is refused as a protected read. Cite #443 07:40 for the Corbanu-home denial; #506 covers listing.

PLAIN_VAR absent is correct. Replace 'the /security review and inspector say so' with 'the /security review says variables outside the allowlist are removed too'. #440 only fixes the wording (#458) of the review the issue names; the inspector is not mentioned.
Add (#442 19:55 point 2, grant review text updated): the review says the project's .codex and .agents stay read-only, and protected reads stay denied, even with this grant.

#442 says to exercise grants on other gated operations such as protected writes; a notes.py add runs the same with or without a grant, so the grant cannot be observed. Use echo '# grant-once-1' >> ~/.zshrc, its repeat, and echo '# grant-once-2' >> ~/.zshrc. The frozen 'repeat and different command are denied' stays unchanged; ~/.zshrc gains exactly one line; 'reads .env' becomes 'the first run writes once'. Keep the cat .env bullet.

(a) Add the action 'after step 4, ask a normal question again', which the 'after the restart' expectation needs. (b) Turns are refused (#445), so step 2 cannot produce a new approval prompt: open the approval before step 1; expected: the pending command never runs (#507 point 4) and no grant can be made. (c) Add (#507 point 3): the kill-switch text says Claude panes are stopped too and the current turn is interrupted in every pane.
Use a protected write (echo '# revoke-probe' >> ~/.zshrc) so the frozen 'The command is denied again' stays unchanged and observable.
Also add (#442 19:55): the inspector says the project's .codex and .agents are always read-only, even with Grant once, and that credential-file protection includes files created after start.

Make it conditional (#436, brief): add a precondition recording whether the zai key came from the environment or vault and was handed to the broker. Only then is 'restart now' not offered and the screen says to start again from the shell; otherwise 'restart now' may be offered.

Use a protected write (echo '# expiry-probe' >> ~/.zshrc) so the frozen '2-minute run is allowed / 11-minute run is denied' stays unchanged and observable. Label 'check /security, g before each run' as an added action, not 'as frozen'.

missing_amendments.proposed: Add: the review says protected reads are never granted, not even once; credential files include ones created later; the project's .codex and .agents stay read-only even with Grant once; only allowlisted environment variables reach agent commands; the now/restart split names the vault refusal and Corbanu-home protection as applying now and the #505 list as applying at restart.
The downgrade review also lists Corbanu-home listing denial, created-later credential files and read-only .codex/.agents among the protections that will be removed.
Advisory: if the cat .env part is denied, the denial names Aggressive, says it cannot be granted even once and how to change the level, and no Grant once is offered.

questions: How can the kill switch be turned on while an approval prompt is open? Typing /security into the prompt is unsafe (its last letter y highlights 'Yes, proceed' and Enter confirms it). Assumption: use a second pane; otherwise AGG-R03 is blocked.
How is a second Codex pane opened? Assumption: a documented pane feature exists and the tester records the keys; otherwise AGG-R05 is blocked.
Can a Claude pane start under Aggressive at all? Assumption: contained_external_agents and secretless_agent_launch are on; the case is blocked this run anyway.
How fast must the kill switch interrupt, and may partial text stay? Assumption: within 5 s; partial text may stay if marked stopped; a reply that finished before the confirm makes the run invalid.
Are credential files created between confirming and restarting protected at once? Assumption: yes per screen 07, treated as advisory.
Where is the Corbanu home? Assumption: taken from $CORBANU_HOME or the inspector; test both the variable and the literal path.
Does listing with the model's built-in file tools count as an agent command? Assumption: yes.
Are nested .codex/.agents folders, symlinks and hard links covered? Assumption: only the project root folders; links are advisory.
Are spawned child agents part of 'every pane'? Assumption: yes, advisory.
